verdict.rationale: The docs say `@coderabbitai review` runs an incremental review of only the new changes, and auto-review settings that 'pause after a set number of commits' imply reviews re-run as commits are pushed. The request-changes workflow keeps review decisions synchronized with resolved feedback, which partly covers tracking fixes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each push automatically triggers an incremental re-review, documentation that previously raised comments are tracked as fixed or auto-resolved rather than repeated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
